overview_description.description:
LeadGenius is an end-to-end sales solution that provides companies with a way to generate, qualify, deliver, and convert leads. It helps sales teams grow and scale across all levels of the sales process.

LeadGenius was launched by Anand Kulkarni, Prayag Narula, and Dave Rolnitzky in  2011.

about_short_description.short_description: LeadGenius is an end-to-end sales solution that provides companies with a way to generate, qualify, deliver, and convert leads.

product.name: Precision Data
product.description: Highly specific and verified data sets tailored to a business's unique needs for targeted outreach.

product.name: Custom Data Signals
product.description: Tailored insights such as product launches, funding events, and strategic hires specific to a business's industry and needs.

product.name: Global Data Acquisition
product.description: Collection and curation of B2B data from over 30 countries with regional expertise and compliance.

product.name: Contact-Level Technographics
product.description: Data revealing detailed skills, contributions, and behaviors of contacts to improve lead qualification and targeting.

product.name: Contact Behavioral Intelligence
product.description: Real-time data on contact behavior and engagement to prioritize outreach based on buyer intent and activity.
